business: Only explicitly selected, complete Definition/v2 bodies may be materialized as candidates. Owner route, exact meaning, scope, notation, provider bytes, successor intention and complete field lineage are mandatory. This does not admit a definition or exercise current owner authority.
bridge: AlchLang selects all source pointers, output layouts, schema/provider bindings and policy roles. Generic adapters observe exact frozen bytes and selected JSON values, invoke compiled decisions, render through the existing shared bound artifact provider and publish exact outputs without overwrite.
system: Inspection establishes the required frozen snapshot first. Each selection is compared with its verified embedded working meaning. Every Definition leaf has exactly one matching lineage witness; witnesses are batch-checked with total cardinality and uniqueness. Output bytes preserve the selected original Definition and lineage bodies. No standalone Define modules are used.
